description: Whether a field is filed as ZZZZ with its name in item 18 (DEP/, DEST/, ALTN/; AIM Appendix 4: ZZZZ where the field has no ICAO location indicator), where a service takes only indicators. Decided by NASR's ICAO_ID (APT_BASE.csv) where the host has the field's row: null or empty is none listed (IL11, BGTL), a four-letter one is filed as it is (Z13 is PFZK). Only where icao_id is left out is the identifier read: one with a figure in it (C81, 06A) is the FAA's own.

icao_id.description: NASR APT_BASE's ICAO_ID for the field: null or "" where NASR lists none. Leave it out only where the host has no NASR row for the field.
